name: Joos de Momper the Younger

summary.text: Joos de Momper the Younger or Joost de Momper the Younger was a Flemish landscape painter active in Antwerp between the late 16th century and the early 17th century. Brueghel's influence is clearly evident in many of de Momper's paintings.
summary.title: Joos de Momper

6057345: River Landscape with a Boar Hunt, or Dutch: Rivierlandschap met everzwijnjacht, is a c. 1600 painting by the Flemish artist Joos de Momper, now in the Rijksmuseum, in Amsterdam.
River Landscape with a Boar Hunt
7766701: Storm at Sea is an oil painting on panel attributed the Netherlandish Renaissance artist Pieter Bruegel the Elder, painted c. 1569. It is held in the Kunsthistorisches Museum, in Vienna.
12898663: The Five Senses are a pair of oil paintings made by Jan Brueghel the Elder and others in 1617-1618, at the same time as he was working with Peter Paul Rubens on a series of five paintings on the same topic.
18602102: Landscape with the Fall of Icarus is an oil-on-canvas painting by the Flemish painter Joos de Momper. It was possibly painted in the 1620s, and is currently housed at the Nationalmuseum in Stockholm.
Landscape with the Fall of Icarus (de Momper)
20087553: Landscape with Grotto is an oil-on-panel painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. The painting was completed in the 1610s, possibly in 1616, and is now in the Rheinisches Landesmuseum in Bonn.
21617762: Minerva's Visit to the Muses is an oil-on-oak-panel painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. The painting depicts a scene from Ovid's Metamorphoses, which tells of Minerva visiting the muses on Mount Helicon, to listen to their song and see the Hippocrene.
21723023: Rocky Landscape with a Waterfall is an oil on panel painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. The painting was completed in the early 1610s, and currently housed at the Hermitage Museum in Saint Petersburg.
22695318: Mountainous Landscape with Figures and a Donkey is an oil-on-panel painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. It was completed in the early 17th century.
Dune Landscape with Travelers and Cattle
22695382: Mountain Landscape with Campers and a Broken Tree is an oil-on-panel painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. The painting is currently housed at the National Museum in Warsaw.
Mountain Landscape with Campers and a Broken Tree
27699461: Flemish Market and Washing Place is an oil-on-canvas painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper.
27699870: Landscape with Sea and Mountain is an oil-on-canvas painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. It was painted in the early 1620s, and is now in the Museum of Prado in Madrid.
27967982: Mountainous Landscape with Figures and a Donkey is an oil-on-canvas painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. It was painted in the early 17th century and is currently housed at the Hermitage Museum in Saint Petersburg.
Mountainous Landscape with Figures and a Donkey
27982771: Mountain Landscape with Castle is an oil-on-panel painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. It was probably completed in the 1600s.
27982774: Mountain Landscape is a large oil-on-canvas painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. The painting was probably completed in the 1620s and is currently housed at the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna.
29656600: Monk's Hermitage in a Cave is an oil painting on panel by the Flemish painter Joos de Momper. Its date of execution is unknown.
29656601: Mountainous Landscape with a Bridge and Four Horsemen is an oil painting on canvas by the Flemish landscapist Joos de Momper. Its date of execution is unknown.
Mountainous Landscape with a Bridge and Four Horsemen
49221725: Landscape with Grotto and a Rider is an oil-on-panel painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. It was completed in the 1610s, possibly in 1616.
Landscape with Grotto and a Rider
60022102: Landscape is an oil on panel painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper.
Landscape (Jan Brueghel the Elder and de Momper)
60022103: A Farm is an oil on panel painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper.
60022105: Excursion in the Countryside of Infanta Isabel Clara Eugenia is an oil on canvas painting by Flemish artists Jan Brueghel the Elder and Joos de Momper. It was painted in the first quarter of the 17th century, and is housed at the Museum of Prado, in Madrid.
Excursion in the Countryside of Infanta Isabel Clara Eugenia
60022107: The Infanta Isabel Clara Eugenia in the Mariemont Park is a large oil on canvas painting by Flemish artists Jan Brueghel the Elder and Joos de Momper. It was painted in the first quarter of the 17th century.
The Infanta Isabel Clara Eugenia in the Mariemont Park
60023115: Landscape with Skater is an oil on canvas painting by Flemish artist Joos de Momper. The painting is today considered a collaboration between the latter and Jan Brueghel the Elder.
99932629: Mountain Landscape with the Temptation of Christ is an oil-on-oak-panel painting by the Flemish painters Joos de Momper who painted the landscape and Sebastiaen Vrancx who painted the figures. The painting is now in the National Gallery in Prague.
Landscape with the Temptation of Christ
100409942: Summer Landscape with Harvesters is an oil-on-canvas painting by Flemish artists Joos de Momper and Jan Brueghel the Elder. It was painted in the first quarter of the 17th century, probably around 1610, and is currently housed at the Museum of Art in Toledo, Ohio.
100989325: Landscape with a Mountain Pass is a large oil-on-canvas painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. It was completed sometime between 1600 and 1625.
100989352: Large Mountain Landscape is a large oil-on-canvas painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. The painting was completed in the early 17th century.
100989395: Mountain Landscape with Pilgrims in a Grotto Chapel, also known as A Hermit before a Grotto, is an oil on panel painting by Flemish painters Joos de Momper and Jan Brueghel the Elder. The painting was completed at some time between 1610 and 1626.
Mountain Landscape with Pilgrims in a Grotto Chapel
101006908: Mountain Scene with Bridges is an oil-on-oak-panel painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper.
101007261: Tobias' Journey is an oil-on-panel painting by Flemish artist Joos de Momper. The painting showcases Momper's large scale, imaginary landscape painting and his interpretation of perspective in distant views while at the same time treating a biblical subject.
101008723: Village at Full Moon is a tempera-on-panel painting by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. It was painted in the early 17th century, possibly in the 1620s, and is now in the National Gallery in Prague.
104127771: Landscape with a View of the Sea at Sunset is a pen and ink wash drawing by Flemish painter Joos de Momper. It was painted in 1610, and is now in the British Museum in London.
Landscape with a View of the Sea at Sunset
104155887: Grotto Landscape with a Hermitage, also called The Reading Hermit, is an oil on canvas painting by Flemish painters Jan Brueghel the Younger and Joos de Momper. It was painted around 1625, and is currently in private collection.
